## Outcome
Done: the bug in `src/inventory.ts` is fixed and both inventory tests pass.

## Changes
- `src/inventory.ts` line 6 in `reserve`: the guard was `if (have <= qty)`, which refused to take the last units. It is now `if (have < qty)`, so `reserve` takes `qty` units whenever that many are left, as the doc comment says.

## Verification
- `node --test test/inventory.test.ts`: met. 2 pass, 0 fail. The run output shows `inStock` and `reserve can take the last units` both passing.
- `src/inventory.ts` is the only file I changed: met.

## Open issues
- `test/checkout.test.ts` ("checkout throws when out of stock") is outside my scope. `src/checkout.ts` ignores a failed `reserve` (`if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { continue; }`) instead of throwing `out of stock <sku>`, so that test will likely still fail until the checkout subagent fixes it.
